ApiKeyHelp: Routarr generates one at first start unless ROUTARR_API_KEY is set. Stored in this browser only and sent as X-Api-Key.
ApiKeyHelpSession: Sign-in uses your session; this key is for clients that cannot hold one, such as scripts and monitoring. Stored in this browser only and sent as X-Api-Key.
ApiKeyKeepHint: Leave blank to keep the current key
ApiKeyMintedOnce: Copy it now — it is shown once and cannot be read again.
ApiKeyPinned: ROUTARR_API_KEY sets this key, so it cannot be changed here.
ApiKeyPlaintextHint: Stored in plaintext from an older version — re-save the instance to encrypt it
ApiKeyRejected: That key was refused. Check it and try again.
ApiKeyRequired: This Routarr needs an API key
ApiKeyStored: API key stored in this browser.
ApiKeyChooseOwn: To choose the key yourself instead, set {variable} and restart Routarr.
ApiKeyDockerCommand: With the Docker image, this command prints it:
ApiKeyGeneratedFile: Routarr generated it at first start, printed it in the log and saved it as {file} next to the database. The key is kept in this browser only.
ApiKeyWhereHint: From Settings → General in the Arr
ApplyAllHint: Applies every move this run proposed, including those beyond the displayed list, in batches.
AutoApplyWarning: Automatic application is armed: a routing decision for a media with no files yet is written to Radarr/Sonarr as soon as it is made, without confirmation.
BackupTogetherHint: A configuration export never contains your Arr API keys — they are sealed with a key held by this installation only. For a full backup, copy data/routarr.db and data/routarr.key together: without the key, the stored keys are unrecoverable.
BackupsHelp: Taken on a schedule and kept beside the database. Each archive holds the database, the master key and the API key — everything a restore needs, which makes the file as sensitive as the key itself.
BatchApplyStopped: Stopped after a failure. Applied: {applied} of {candidates}. Batches run: {run} of {planned}. The rest is still pending.
CapacityShortWarning: {path} would receive {needed} but reports only {free} free.
CategoryNameHint: Lower-cased automatically. Letters, digits, '-' and '_' only.
ConditionLabelAddedWithinDays: Added within the last N days
ConditionValuesHelp: Each condition is a requirement; the values inside it combine as the selector says — any of them, or all of them.
ConfigImportResult: Restored — settings: {settings}, categories: {categories}, instances: {instances}, mappings: {folders}, overrides: {overrides}.
ConfigImportNeedsKey: Instances waiting for their API key: {names}
ConfirmApply: Items to be re-pointed in Radarr/Sonarr: {count}
ConfirmApplyAll: Items to be reassigned in Radarr/Sonarr, in batches: {count}
ConfirmApplyWithFiles: and their files moved on disk.
ConfirmDeleteBackup: Delete the backup {name}? It is the only copy — nothing else holds this snapshot.
ConfirmDeleteInstance: Delete “{name}”? Its media, mappings and overrides are removed from Routarr (nothing is deleted in the Arr).
ConfirmDeleteOverride: Remove the override on “{title}”? The rules take over again.
ConfirmPurge: Purge decisions, logs and job history beyond the retention window?
ConfirmRemoveKey: Remove the API key? Clients using it stop working immediately.
ConfirmRestore: Restore {name}? It replaces the current database, the master key and the API key. Nothing changes until Routarr is restarted.
ConfirmRevertFiles: Move the files on disk back as well?
ConfirmRotateKey: Regenerate the API key? Every client still using the current one stops working until it is updated.
ConflictDuplicateMapping: Root folders on '{instance}' mapped to '{category}': {count} — routing would pick one arbitrarily
ConflictOrphaned: Root folder mapped to '{category}', which is no longer a known category
ConflictUnmapped: No root folder on '{instance}' is mapped to '{category}'; matching media will be skipped
DashboardSubtitle: What Routarr knows about your library and what it is waiting to do about it.
DiagnosticsSubtitle: Connectivity, metadata coverage and anything that would silently stop routing from working.
ErrorApplyInProgress: Another apply run is already in progress
ErrorBatchLimit: Batch size {count} exceeds the limit of {limit}. Reduce the selection or raise batch_limit in Settings.
ErrorConfirmationRequired: Items over the confirmation threshold of {threshold}: {count}. Re-send with confirm = true to proceed.
ErrorDryRunEnabled: Global dry-run mode is enabled. Disable it in Settings to apply changes.
ErrorNotEnoughSpace: {path} would receive {needed} but reports only {free} free. Re-send with confirm = true to move anyway.
ExclusionsLabel: Exclusions (veto this rule when any of these match)
FacetsWithoutMetadata: Items with neither a genre nor an original language: {count} — no metadata condition can see them.
HistorySubtitle: Every classification decision, why it was made, and what happened to it.
ImportReplaceQuestion:
Replace every existing rule with the ones in this file?

Cancel to append them instead.
IncludeSuperseded: Include proposals replaced by a newer run
InstancesSubtitle: Radarr and Sonarr servers Routarr reads from and writes to. API keys are encrypted at rest.
LiveModeWarning: Global dry-run is OFF — applying a decision will write to Radarr/Sonarr immediately.
LogsSubtitle: Every write Routarr made to Radarr and Sonarr.
MediaExplorerSubtitle: Everything synchronized from Radarr and Sonarr, with the category the engine currently proposes for it.
MetadataMissingCount: Still missing metadata: {count} — genre, keyword and certification rules cannot classify them yet.
MoveFilesLabel: Move the files on disk too (Radarr/Sonarr moveFiles) — leave off to only re-point the library entry.
Name: Name
NoDecisionRecorded: No decision recorded yet — run a simulation.
NoInstanceYet: No instance connected yet — start on the Instances page.
NoMediaMatches: No media matches. Sync an instance from the Instances page to populate this list.
NoMetadataCached: No external metadata cached — genre, keyword and certification conditions cannot match.
NoOverrides: No override — every media item is classified by the rules.
NoRootFolderDiscovered: No root folder discovered yet — add an instance and sync it.
NoRuleApplies: No rule applies to this media type and instance.
NoRuleTestsHint: Open any title’s explanation and pin the decision. It becomes a case that fails if a later rule change moves it.
NoRulesYet: No rules yet — every media item falls back to the default category.
NoValueInLibrary: The library carries no value for this yet
NoWritesYet: Nothing has been written to Radarr or Sonarr yet.
NotFoundHelp: Check the address, or pick a screen from the menu.
NotValidJson: That file is not valid JSON
OverridesSubtitle: Explicit human decisions. An override outranks every rule, whatever their priority.
PasswordWhere: The password was generated at first start: it is in the server log, and in routarr.password beside the database.
PendingCapped: Showing the first {count} pending decisions; run a simulation to see them all.
PinAsRuleTestHint: Require this title to keep landing in this category, and report it if a rule change moves it.
PinMediaTitle: Pin a media item to a category
PreviewSummary: Media items changing category: {changed}. Moves required would go from {beforeMoves} to {afterMoves}, unclassified from {beforeUnmatched} to {afterUnmatched}.
PreviewTitle: Impact preview — nothing has been saved
ReasonNoRuleMatched: ✗ No rule matched — falling back to default category '{category}'
ReasonPlaceholder: Why the rules get this one wrong
RenameCategoryHint: Rules, folder mappings, overrides and the decision history all follow the new name.
RequestTimedOut: The server did not answer in time. Check that Routarr is running, then try again.
RestoreStaged: Restore staged. Restart Routarr to apply it.
RestoreStagedWithoutKey: Restore staged — it will be applied at the next start. This archive carries no master key, so the stored Radarr and Sonarr credentials will have to be entered again.
RootFoldersSubtitle: Map the folders Radarr and Sonarr already know about to your functional categories.
RuleAmbiguous: same name and priority as another rule
RuleShadowedHint: Items matched and never won: {count} — “{rule}” takes them first.
RuleTestsFailed: Cases no longer routing where they were pinned: {failed} of {total}.
RuleTestsPassed: All cases still route where they were pinned — {total} checked.
RuleTestsSubtitle: Pinned decisions, replayed against the rules as they stand. The preview says what a change would do; these say what it must not do.
RulesSubtitle: Priority-ordered conditions that classify media into target categories. The first matching rule wins.
SecretConfiguredPlaceholder: A key is stored — type to replace it
SettingAutoApplyHelp: Applies a routing decision as soon as it is made, without waiting for a click — but only for media that have no files yet, so nothing is ever moved on disk. Global dry-run still overrides everything.
SettingAutoSimulateHelp: Keeps the pending decision list current without pressing Simulate.
SettingAutoSyncHelp: Poll each instance on its own interval.
SettingBackupEnabledHelp: Take one automatically, on the interval below.
SettingBackupIntervalHelp: How long between two scheduled backups.
SettingBackupRetentionHelp: Past this count, the oldest is deleted.
SettingBatchLimitHelp: Hard ceiling on how many items a single apply may touch.
SettingCertificationRegionsHelp: Comma-separated ISO 3166-1 codes, most preferred first (e.g. FR, US).
SettingConfirmationThresholdHelp: Above this many items, applying requires a second, explicit confirmation.
SettingDecisionRetentionHelp: Pending and skipped decisions older than this are purged. 0 disables the purge.
SettingDefaultCategoryHelp: Used when no rule matches a media item.
SettingGlobalDryRunHelp: While on, Routarr refuses every write to Radarr and Sonarr, whatever you click.
SettingLogRetentionHelp: Execution logs and job history older than this are purged. 0 disables the purge.
SettingMetadataProvidersHelp: Priority order, highest first: the first source that has a value wins it, and the ones below fill in what it left empty.
SettingMetadataTtlHelp: How long metadata stays fresh before it is re-fetched.
SettingNotificationWebhookHelp: A URL Routarr posts JSON to when something fails while nobody is watching: an Arr it can no longer reach, or an automatic apply the Arr refused. Sent once per transition, not on every retry. Works with Discord, Gotify, ntfy and Apprise. Leave empty to disable.
SettingOmdbKeyHelp: Adds certifications and countries from IMDb data. Stored encrypted; leave blank to keep the current one, or to fall back to OMDB_API_KEY.
SettingRefreshAfterMoveHelp: Ask the Arr to refresh the moved items so it picks up their new location.
SettingSchedulerIntervalHelp: How often the scheduler wakes up to check which instances are due.
SettingTmdbKeyHelp: A v3 key or a v4 read access token. Adds keywords and origin countries, which no Arr reports. Stored encrypted; leave blank to keep the current one, or to fall back to TMDB_API_KEY.
SettingTvdbKeyHelp: Series-oriented, and the only source with a per-country certification. Stored encrypted; leave blank to keep the current one, or to fall back to TVDB_API_KEY.
SignInRefused: The sign-in did not complete. Try again.
SignInWithProviderHelp: Routarr does not hold your password: your identity provider decides who gets in.
SimulationEmptyState: Run a simulation to see what Routarr would do. Nothing is written until you apply.
SimulationSubtitle: Evaluate every rule against the library and review each proposed move — with its justification — before anything is written.
SkippedUnmappedWarning: Items matching a category with no root folder on their instance: {count}. They will be skipped — map it under Root Folders.
TasksSubtitle: Every background run — sync, enrichment, simulation, apply, revert, backup and housekeeping — with its progress and failures.
Title: Title
TruncatedWarning: Showing the {shown} most actionable of {total} decisions. The counters above cover the whole library.
UiLanguageHelp: Language of the interface and of the messages Routarr produces.
Unauthorized: Unauthorized — set your Routarr API key in Settings.
ValidationCategoryUnmapped: Category '{name}' is not mapped to any root folder — matching media will be skipped
ValidationConditionEmpty: Condition #{index} ({kind}) has no value and will never match
ValidationConditionNoSource: Condition #{index} ({kind}) needs {field}, which no enabled source provides
ValidationContradiction: Conditions '{first}' and '{second}' contradict each other and can never both match
ValidationDaysNegative: Condition #{index}: a negative number of days ({value}) can never match
ValidationExclusionConflict: Condition '{kind}' is both required and excluded — the rule can never fire
ValidationNameTooLong: Rule name is limited to {max} characters
ValidationNoConditions: A rule needs at least one condition
ValidationYearImplausible: Condition #{index}: the year {year} is outside the {min}–{max} range Routarr accepts
ValidationYearRangeInverted: Condition #{index}: the year range {min}–{max} is inverted and will never match
WarnApiExternalAuth: Authentication is delegated to a reverse proxy: anything reaching this port directly is unauthenticated.
WarnApiUnauthenticated: The API is unauthenticated — set ROUTARR_API_KEY.
WarnInstanceNoMapping: Instance '{name}' has no root folder mapped to a category.
WarnMissingMetadata: Media items with no external metadata yet: {count}.
WarnNoEnabledInstance: No enabled Arr instance — nothing to route.
WarnProviderNeedsKey: {provider} is in the source list but has no API key: what only it provides cannot match.
WarnProviderUnreachable: {provider} is configured but unreachable, or its credential was rejected.
WarnSchedulerPanicked: Unattended background passes that failed in the last 24 hours: {count}. Syncing continued, but check the server log.
WarnSettingAboveMaximum: Setting '{key}' is {value}, above the maximum of {max} — it stays as it is until it is saved lower.
WarnUnmappedCategories: Categories not mapped to any root folder: {count} — matching media will be skipped.
WebhookTokenRotated: Webhook token rotated — update it in the Arr
WebhookUrlCopied: Webhook URL copied to the clipboard
WebhookUrlCopyFailed: The browser blocked the clipboard. Webhook URL: {url}
CommandPaletteHint: The library is searched by title, and the screens by name.
ErrorTargetUnreachable: '{path}' is not answering — last reached {since}. Applying now may fail.
ConflictUnreachableSince: Root folder '{path}' did not answer — last reached {since}
DeclareDestinationHelp: A folder the instance can reach, even one it does not list as a root folder. Declare one root folder in Radarr or Sonarr and name the targets beneath it here. The path is checked against that instance, not against this machine.
ErrorCapacityUnknown: '{path}' does not report free space, and it sits under no known root folder — {needed} would be moved without anything checking the room.
ErrorDestinationAbsolute: A destination is an absolute path, starting with /
ErrorDestinationAlreadyListed: '{path}' is already listed for this instance
ErrorDestinationUnseen: The instance cannot see '{path}'. Check the path as that container sees it.
ErrorDestinationNotOurs: That folder comes from the instance; remove it there instead
ErrorCategoryAlreadyMapped: Category '{category}' is already mapped to '{path}' on this instance
